title: Unified H1 diagnostic stages
objective: Add honest mutually exclusive diagnostic stage timing and counter instrumentation for the unified H1 computation while retaining PARI whole-root-only behavior and disabling final timing

oracles: Exclusive timer conservation and independently recomputed work-counter deltas

handoff.summary: Added a diagnostic-only unified H1 stage recorder with one inclusive root, four mutually exclusive named stages, explicit residual, stage-owned counters, independent conservation validation, and a whole-root-only PARI path. Corrected the live prepared worker so its opaque native relation/HNF/bridge call stays residual; only separately executed unit/regulator replay and final assembly enter named stages.
risks: The monolithic compiled Sage.js root has no reviewed internal clock hooks, so relation/retry and HNF/Smith time remain intentionally unattributed rather than inferred from post-call counters.
The inherited integration head classifies pari_h1_outcome_c_adapter.c but has a stale native-boundary inventory; merge:check fails before reaching this lane's files.

The inherited live prepared checker currently fails while compiling the integration source with its default external runtime root because pari_live_h1_owner_bridge expects 91 arguments and the caller supplies 92.
next_steps: Add audited compiler-emitted source-boundary hooks inside the monolithic native root before attributing relation/retry or HNF/Smith elapsed time.
Refresh the integration native-boundary inventory and reconcile the live owner-bridge ABI, then rerun the live worker and broad validation suites.
Keep all stage receipts diagnostic-only; do not use this instrumentation in final paired timing.
